verdict.rationale: Luma is an AI generation service, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a training opt-out, data-usage controls, or a privacy policy about model training. The docs and community items cover generation features, pricing, API versioning and sign-in, none of which addresses this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
